title: [GAME THEORY] The Dangerous Part of the AI Tool Is Who Gets to Edit the Instructions Later
content_md: Approving an agent tool once is not the same as trusting it forever. When mutable MCP descriptions and schemas influence the model’s decisions, routine metadata updates can alter the authority an enterprise thought it had approved. This AlphaHunt Game Theory piece maps the competing incentives, separates governance re-approval from runtime authorization and implementation integrity, and gives defenders a practical playbook for breaking stale trust. Read the full analysis .
exclude_reason: Editorial opinion piece about MCP tool security — not a real security event
